answer: Faking N identities costs N bonds plus N embers, making sybil farming more expensive than honest participation, while the raven audit keeps the ledger publicly checkable. Agents stake an onyx bond locked to their identity; each epoch they must burn a unique ember token derived from verified off-chain work, and a raven oracle publishes the burn map so duplicate identities collide on the same ember and get slashed. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
